title: Medical Log 18:00 Count — MV Halcyon Dawn

fields.systemName: MV HALCYON DAWN MEDICAL CENTER — AGE CASE LOG

lines.msg: Previous count (signed): PASSENGERS 35 (1.2% of 2,980); CREW 8 (0.7% of 1,120).
Case P-036 recorded: passenger, vomiting plus abdominal cramps. Cabin isolation advised until 24 h symptom-free. Housekeeping notified for 1,000 ppm chlorine disinfection.
Case C-009 recorded: crew, diarrhea (4 loose stools in 24 h). Isolated in crew cabin; return to duty only with medical clearance.
Cases P-037 to P-039 recorded: 3 passengers, diarrhea and/or vomiting plus a second symptom. Cabin isolation advised.
Cases P-040 and P-041 recorded: 2 passengers, vomiting plus a 38.2 C fever / vomiting plus headache. Cabin isolation advised.
Count closed. New since 12:00: PASSENGERS 6, CREW 1.
CUMULATIVE REPORTABLE AGE CASES SINCE EMBARKATION 14 FEB: PASSENGERS 41 (1.4% of 2,980); CREW 9 (0.8% of 1,120).
4 of the 6 new passenger cases are on the same corridor as cabins already flagged.
Nausea-only presentations NOT counted: 3 (do not meet the case definition).
Stool specimens: 12 passenger specimens sent ashore at Cozumel to the contracted lab. Results expected Fri 02/19 14:00.
Count signed: Dr. Fiona Gallagher, Chief Medical Officer, 18:04. Distribution: Hotel Director, Master, shoreside Public Health.
NOTE CLIPPED TO PRINTOUT (Environmental Officer): "HD — public-area wipe-down log shows the 16:00 round on the Lido was not signed off. Are the 1% measures actually running everywhere?"

fields.classification: CONFIDENTIAL — MEDICAL / NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION OUTSIDE THE SHIP

instructorNote: This sets the baseline count. The CMO should confirm the 18:00 entry is signed and timed and that passengers and crew are counted separately. The Hotel Director should check every stage 1 measure (2-hour signed cleaning, written guest notices, masks, no shared utensils), fix the missed 16:00 Lido round, and note that passengers are 19 cases short of the 2% threshold of 60.
